message: よすが
Lately, the number of Demons has been increasing, and for some reason they're often spotted at Prier at night. Just to be safe, I'll go check things out.

name: Synn
message: 「W-Wha?!」
The familiar, cheerful chatter was absent from Prier after school. Usually, plenty of students would be enjoying tea at this hour, yet no one was there.

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu. Watch veeery closely now, Azel-chan?」

name: Azel
message: 「Understood. I am watching.」
Azel and Helena-san were standing beside the table closest to the serving counter.
Numerous small bottles of juice were lined up on the table. None of them were uncapped, all unopened... Were the two of them planning to drink that much?

name: Helena
message: 「Shuu!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yikes?!」
Helena-san's slender hand flashed. The next instant, a small bottle split cleanly in two, juice spilling out.

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's an amazing technique, though it's such a waste.」

name: Azel
message: 「Incorrect. Every single one of these is past its expiration date.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, Synn-chan\s04 Did you come to help out?」

name: Helena
message: 「Shau!」

name: Azel
message: 「Pointless.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, I could never pull off a finishing move like that.」

name: Azel
message: 「No. I am saying it is meaningless.」

name: Azel
message: 「I asked for a method to remove the bottle caps. This chairwoman is merely smashing them open.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my? If you do it like this, sometimes it pops right off by chance, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... Couldn't you just use a bottle opener?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Unnecessary.」
Azel lowered her gaze to the table.
Looking closely, a bottle opener was already sitting there, with several bent bottle caps scattered around it.
Including Prier, the soft drink vending machines installed at Ryuusei Academy come in two types: paper cup and small bottle. There isn't a single standard canned drink machine anywhere.
Bottled beer tastes way better than canned beer, right! Therefore, the juice students drink should be bottled too!
That is Helena-san's policy.

name: Azel
message: 「One more.」

name: Azel
message: 「A failure.」

name: Synn
message: 「It came off cleanly, though? Isn't that a success?」

name: Azel
message: 「No good. The bottle cap got bent.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... aah, so that's what this is about!!」
Even if I don't know Azel's goal, it makes sense to me now. She's trying to collect undamaged bottle caps.
Apparently, back when Mom and Dad were around my age, vending machines for bottled juice were a common sight all over town.
And out of childish curiosity, kids used to collect bottle caps from all sorts of brands.
The vending machines at Ryuusei Academy mostly carry minor brands. In this day and age, if you stubbornly keep making bottled juice, that's probably just how things turn out.
Maybe thanks to that, you can spot all kinds of bottle caps with interesting designs here and there.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey Azel, this small bottle comes with a prize draw.」

name: Azel
message: 「A prize draw? What is that?」

name: Synn
message: 「You know how canned drink vending machines sometimes have that electronic roulette for a free bonus? This is the bottle version of that. Actually, bottles might've been the original.」

name: Synn
message: 「There's a sticker on the underside of the bottle cap, and you don't know if you won or lost until you peel it back.」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, in terms of sheer excitement, this one is far superior.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see, understood. Winning one would likely bring joy.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a weird way to put it, considering it's for yourself?」

name: Azel
message: 「It is not.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then who's it for?」

name: Azel
message: 「...I do not know.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hohohoho, which girl around us is it who collects strange trinkets like these, I wonder?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Lolotte--」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I do not know!」
Lolotte has been feeling down lately.
In her own way, Azel is trying her hardest to cheer Lolotte up, isn't she.

name: Azel
message: 「Hey, Chairwoman, order some alcohol and hand over its bottle cap to me.」

name: Helena
message: 「Too bad♪ I'm abstaining from alcohol.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Impossible!? Helena-san is...!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you making a wish?」

name: Helena
message: 「Jeez, it's about mindfulness.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, right, Azel-chan is the type people make wishes to, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「...I told you I don't know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!?」

name: Azel
message: 「What is it?」

name: Helena
message: 「These are coins.」
Suddenly, three coins fly in from out of nowhere and stab into the table.

name: Helena
message: 「Heehee, that's Tamiko-chan. Still, I wonder what she means?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh yeah, when I was little, my dad taught me. If you place a coin on top when using a bottle opener, the bottle cap won't bend.」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that true?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's true.」

name: Helena
message: 「Ta-da! It's perfect. Leave it to Tamiko-chan♪」
An arrow-letter reading 'You're welcome, Helena' hits the table.

name: Helena
message: 「What a celebration! I've got to order some drinks right away! Let's invite Melilot for a toast!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, weren't you abstaining from alcohol?」

name: Helena
message: 「I held out for a whole half-day, you know? That's more than enough\s04 I'll treat Synn-chan and Azel-chan to some fake champagne too♪」

name: Azel
message: 「...Hmph.」
Paying Helena-san no mind, Azel silently pops off the bottle cap.

name: Azel
message: 「Hey.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, what is it?」
Azel, whose expression had softened, suddenly puts on a serious face and calls out to me.
Crap...! Of course she'd get grumpy if I stared at her like that.

name: Azel
message: 「Ryuusei Town doesn't have any glass-bottle vending machines. Why?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, there used to be one a while back. If there's a photo book or something from back then, I'm sure it'll be in there?」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. Let's take a look.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Hehe.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ngh!?」
Azel secretly slipped the bottle cap, which had "Winner" written on the back, into her pocket.
I held back a gasp of amused surprise and pretended not to notice.
Because for Azel, the winning crown is sure to serve as a reminder of her feelings for Lolotte and the events of today
